attributes.compiler_variant_note: The one-ULP row deserves a second look by a compiler-hunt lane. Under IEEE-correct decimal conversion every natural spelling of that constant (0.4999999995, 0.5 - 5e-10, 0.5*0.999999999, 0.999999999/2) lands on ...FA1, which is what OUR mwcceppc 1.2.5 emitted from the literal that was there; retail holds ...FA0, one ULP below. Either the original source spelled the 17-digit form now written, or the retail build's decimal-to-double conversion rounds differently from ours - which would be a third out-of-archive compiler fingerprint alongside the MWCC jumptable law. Population measured this pass: 1 row in 71 census functions, so the evidence is currently too thin to decide.
attributes.gameplay_defects_fixed: getSinCos is a MATH defect with visual consequences: retail evaluates sin over a RADIAN argument reduced against pi/2 and pi, with the true Taylor coefficients -1/6, 1/120, -1/5040 (f32 0xBE2AAAAB, 0x3C088889, 0xB9500D01 - each verified to round-trip from the literal now written). Our source reduced against 0.5 and 1.0 (a half-turn parameterisation) and used the coefficients -0.16f and 0.008f with a leading 1.0f - a different, wrong polynomial. Every particle direction that goes through getSinCos (getNewDirCone* and the two call sites at mb_particle.c:530/595) was computing the wrong angle. The instruction stream was already byte-identical, so no score anywhere could see it. The other three are diagnostic strings (two error messages and a missing newline) - correctness of the shipped text, not behaviour.
attributes.law_screen: claim.law.SL_pool-constant-errors-are-score-invisible.20260901.v1 APPLIED (all four fixes moved zero score). claim.law.ES_aligned-positional-pool-relocation-mismatch-is-a-score-invisible-defect-class.20260903.v1 APPLIED: three of the four functions read real 0, so their positional pairing is exact by construction; UpdateFXStreak is real 136 and was decided on the VALUE MULTISET instead (see attributes.method), which is why only one of its two census rows was acted on. claim.law.TQ_a-text-only-identity-check-reads-a-pooled-value-edit-as-a-fold-away.20260902.v1 APPLIED: every fix verified by the POOL-DEFECT row disappearing from `fndiff --clean`, not by the gate.
attributes.method: For UpdateFXStreak the census offered two rows; only one is real. Row +0x1c (target f64 0x3FDFFFFFFF768FA0 vs ours 0x3FDFFFFFFF768FA1) is a genuine ONE-ULP value difference and was fixed. Row +0x40 (target 0.1 vs ours 0.8) is a PAIRING ARTIFACT: both 0.1 and 0.8 are present in both streams (sfx.c:3839-3840 spells them one line apart) and the function is real 136, so relocation index k does not name the same instruction on both sides. The value-multiset screen separates the two cases in zero builds; positional reading alone would have 'fixed' a correct line.
